implementation.behavior: Validator returns the exact signed Python int. Existing RNG initialization and seed+offset expressions remain unchanged. ArgumentTypeError includes valid interval and reserved offset; all validation happens during parse_args.

test_scope: For offsets 2,5,6, accepted lower/upper bounds and negative/zero/default-like values initialize every derived real Torch Generator; signed values and sampled values equal direct unchanged seeding.
Real Torch accepts the otherwise-legal upper base; its first disallowed derived stream raises Overflow. Below-minimum seeds also raise Overflow.
Five real CLI main parsers reject lower overflow, derived upper overflow, and noninteger input with exit 2 before output creation or checkpoint reads.
Five real CLI main parsers preserve their actual defaults, minimum, maximum, -1, and 0; tests stop immediately after successful parsing.
limits: No full candidate training or sampling CLI process executed. Parent will perform actual subprocess regressions and full quality checks after integration.
No complete repository test suite run for this isolated candidate.
Existing ordinary smallest-scale baseline runs and failures are recorded separately in /tmp/genai-cli-contract-round63.json.

independent_interface_review.assessment: A small argparse type factory is sufficient; no new registry, stream abstraction, or seed normalization is necessary.
independent_interface_review.negative_seed_semantics: Preserve signed bases before adding offsets. In actual Torch, -1 maps to uint64 maximum while (-1+1) seeds the next stream with 0; pre-normalizing would change behavior. Actual minimum maps to 2**63. No negative-remapping formula from the docstring is copied.
independent_interface_review.max_offset_contract: A fixed nonnegative internal constant chosen at each CLI call site, currently 2/5/6. The helper does not expose this as a user parameter.
independent_interface_review.compatibility: Every previously usable seed remains usable; previously accepted but overflowing seeds now receive early usage errors. Defaults and all existing RNG expressions are unchanged.
